scientific_question: Does correlating quantization error through one persistent blockwise integer lattice repair the attention-c_proj chord failure without a dense residual or future information?

theory.causal_decoder: At step t, keep signed integer codes q_t and FP16 block scales s_t. Decode Delta W_t = s_t q_t. The running-max scale is monotone and depends only on displacements observed through t; q_t is the nearest lattice state.
theory.oracle_ceiling: Trajectory-max scale uses future maxima and is ineligible for selection. It answers whether a single fixed lattice can represent the path at all; a gap between oracle and running-max isolates scale acquisition rather than coordinate support.
theory.causal_difference: Independent least-squares scales changed every snapshot and made int4 decoded chords 1.609x too large despite 96.06% state recovery. A shared scale correlates state errors, so decode(q_t)-decode(q_{t-1}) no longer contains a global per-snapshot rescaling term.
theory.bitwidth_frontier: Int4 preserves the prior 7.99x storage reduction. Int6 is a theoretically packed 5.33x intermediate. Int8 is the native full-support control at approximately 4x less storage than FP32. All use the same block-4096 geometry.
theory.no_dense_carry: No dense residual, error feedback, momentum surrogate, learned dense basis, or future snapshot is available to a causal arm. Current codes and FP16 scales are the entire persistent displacement state.
theory.unchanged_gate: State and chord thresholds are copied from the rejected independent-code plan. Only the temporal lattice structure and the explicitly reported storage ceiling change.

protocol.selection_order: Only causal running-max arms are eligible. Among arms passing every frozen check, select minimum bits, then maximum aggregate chord recovery. Oracle arms are diagnostic ceilings only.

decision_rule.pass: A causal pass authorizes only a counted prototype codec, focused correctness tests, and a separately registered exact-config performance gate. It does not authorize LM training or a larger rung.
decision_rule.oracle_only: If only a future-informed oracle arm passes, do not implement or train. Isolate a causal scale-acquisition rule in another zero-update gate.
decision_rule.fail: Close one-code-per-weight fixed integer lattices through int8 for persistent attention c_proj and return to an explicitly richer temporal representation.

identity.source_amendment: Before any oracle execution, the focused test found that Tensor.maximum_ is not a PyTorch API. The implementation and its matching test were changed to copy_(torch.maximum(...)); no protocol, threshold, candidate, identity, or decision rule changed and no trajectory measurement had been observed.

execution.expected_duration: under five minutes; zero-update two-pass trajectory lattice analysis
